description: This file defines a class BidiPDF responsible for generating PDF data from a browsing context, including handling page formats, margins, orientation, and other print options. It includes utility functions for unit conversion and references external modules for session handling and protocol channels.

classes.name: BidiPDF
classes.description: A class for generating PDF buffers from a browsing context with customizable options.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a BidiPDF instance with a BidiSession.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a PDF buffer based on provided page options, including format, margins, orientation, and page ranges.
